title: Thick ,wrinkled up mess after washing and drying flat,  Underside is a cheesy sewed up mess
text:
Thick ,wrinkled up mess after washing and drying flat, Underside is a cheesy sewed up mess. These black with a white plaid placemats I liked the look of , But!
The stitching on the back is just folded over one thick inch,
, and sewn like a 10 yr old would.
Looks cheesy.

My husband and I eat at the eating bar in the kitchen everyday,
And I use the same placemats for the day then they go
in the front load washer, and dryer.
The instructions say after washing lay flat, let them dry.
I have other place mats that say the same thing, but I still put them
In the washer and dryer. Taking these out of the washer they where
A balled up mess, but one went into the dryer! That one is beyond a mess.
I must have at least 10 sets of 4 to 6 fabric place mats and these are the
Worse.
I do not keep anything on the top of my washer, dryer and laundry tower cause
I fold my laundry on the top, so where I’m I going to be laying
6 place mats to dry, and stretch out first, and they still All need to be ironed.
These are placemats that should be easy to wash and dry, and
Should come out of the dryer still looking like new.

I would have used these on my dinning room table when my kids come over, as there
Very casual, But with Covid virus we are all being carful.

That said they looked good before looking at the underside, and washing these,
but there just cheap cheesy junk.

To the thrift shop there all going to.
0 stars if I could.
